gen-gf-bellota-gf-libre-caslon-text: Bellota's s hangs its ends wide, every stroke a single stylus line. Libre Caslon Text, a classic serif, adds gentle thick-thin shifts underneath, so the heading's ribbon-flat letters sit above a body with a softly changing pen weight.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-lustria: Commanding, with an s whose ends swing far from the spine, Bellota draws everything at one stylus width. Lustria begins the body with a wide-mouthed a and middling contrast, giving those hairline-free headings a text serif with a bit more shading.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-maitree: Distinctive in every s, Bellota traces each stroke at the width of one stylus, with ends hanging far from the spine. Maitree's serif curves ebb and swell gently beneath.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-martel: Bellota's s lets its ends hang far from the spine, and each stroke is cut like a fixed-width router bit. And Martel, a serif with understated thick-thin contrast and apertures like a horseshoe magnet, keeps a long passage moving easily.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-mate-sc: Bellota's strokes are a thread of ink, never swelling or tapering. Mate SC, a text serif, answers underneath with stems and hairlines in a close ratio and curves that stop like brush strokes lifted early.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Stout, stylus-drawn lettering with an s that flings its ends outward. And Nanum Myeongjo's serif arches thin slightly as they leave the stem, giving the body a quiet modulation against Bellota's pipe-cleaner strokes.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-serif-jp: Bellota's s hangs its ends far from the spine, and its thin joins are no thinner than its stems. And Noto Serif JP, a classic serif, keeps a steady, faintly modulated line with sturdy hairlines, so a longer passage reads smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-serif-kr: Bellota's s hangs its ends far from the spine, and its pen pressure holds steady from first letter to last. Noto Serif KR, a classic serif, keeps a thinnest point that still carries real weight.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-serif-sc: Noto Serif SC, a classic serif, thickens its round letters slightly at the sides, like a lightly tilted nib, beneath Bellota's hairline-free strokes. Its see-through c openings are the pair's gentlest quality.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-serif-tc: Bellota's s throws its ends far from the spine, and every stroke keeps one constant width. And Noto Serif TC, a classic serif, holds its letters open with subtle, visible modulation, so a longer passage feels settled.
